name: Medical Terminologies MCP
description: Unified MCP server for global medical terminologies - ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC and Brazilian CID-10 - with authoritative ICD-10 to ICD-11 mapping and cross-terminology search.
author: Sidney Bissoli

tools.name: icd11_search
tools.description: Search ICD-11 for diseases/conditions by name or keyword; returns codes, titles and relevance.

tools.name: icd11_lookup
tools.description: Get full ICD-11 entity details (definition, notes, exclusions, synonyms) by code or URI.

tools.name: icd11_hierarchy
tools.description: Navigate ICD-11 parents/children of an entity.

tools.name: icd11_chapters
tools.description: List all 28 ICD-11 chapters (top-level categories).

tools.name: icd11_postcoordination
tools.description: Get ICD-11 postcoordination axes for building composite codes.

tools.name: snomed_search
tools.description: Search SNOMED CT concepts by term (SCTID, FSN, PT). Reference only; production needs IHTSDO license.

tools.name: snomed_concept
tools.description: Get SNOMED CT concept details by SCTID. Reference only; IHTSDO license for production.

tools.name: snomed_hierarchy
tools.description: Get SNOMED CT IS-A parents/children for a concept.

tools.name: snomed_descriptions
tools.description: Get all descriptions/synonyms for a SNOMED CT concept.

tools.name: snomed_ecl
tools.description: Run an ECL (Expression Constraint Language) query over SNOMED CT.

tools.name: loinc_search
tools.description: Search LOINC for lab tests, clinical observations and measurements.

tools.name: loinc_details
tools.description: Get full LOINC details (component, property, timing, system, scale) for a code.

tools.name: loinc_answers
tools.description: Get the valid answer list for a LOINC questionnaire item.

tools.name: loinc_panels
tools.description: Get the structure/members of a LOINC panel or form.

tools.name: rxnorm_search
tools.description: Search RxNorm drugs by brand or generic name (RxCUI, term types).

tools.name: rxnorm_concept
tools.description: Get RxNorm concept details by RxCUI (names, status, related concepts).

tools.name: rxnorm_ingredients
tools.description: Get the active ingredients for a drug by RxCUI.

tools.name: rxnorm_classes
tools.description: Get therapeutic/pharmacologic classes for a drug.

tools.name: rxnorm_ndc
tools.description: Map between RxNorm RxCUI and National Drug Codes (NDC).

tools.name: mesh_search
tools.description: Search MeSH descriptors for indexing / PubMed terms.

tools.name: mesh_descriptor
tools.description: Get full MeSH descriptor details (scope note, tree numbers, synonyms) by ID.

tools.name: mesh_tree
tools.description: Get the MeSH tree hierarchy location(s) for a descriptor.

tools.name: mesh_qualifiers
tools.description: Get the allowed qualifiers (subheadings) for a MeSH descriptor.

tools.name: atc_classify
tools.description: Look up the WHO ATC classification(s) for a drug by name.

tools.name: atc_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an ATC code (levels 1-4) to its class name and level.

tools.name: atc_members
tools.description: List the drugs/substances belonging to an ATC class.

tools.name: cid10_search
tools.description: Search the Brazilian CID-10 (Portuguese, DataSUS V2008) by text; diacritic-insensitive.

tools.name: cid10_lookup
tools.description: Look up a CID-10 code and return its Portuguese name and restriction flags.

tools.name: cid10_chapters
tools.description: List the 22 CID-10 chapters with code ranges and Portuguese titles.

tools.name: cid10_chapter
tools.description: Get one CID-10 chapter and its constituent groups.

tools.name: map_icd10_to_icd11
tools.description: Authoritative ICD-10 to ICD-11 mapping using WHO transition tables (release 2025-01).

tools.name: map_snomed_to_icd10
tools.description: Map a SNOMED CT concept to ICD-10. Reference only; IHTSDO license for production.

tools.name: map_loinc_to_snomed
tools.description: Guidance on obtaining a LOINC to SNOMED CT mapping (not freely available via API).

tools.name: validate_codes
tools.description: Validate a mixed batch of medical codes against their source terminologies.

tools.name: find_equivalent
tools.description: Search equivalent terms across ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm and MeSH.

tools.name: terminology_versions
tools.description: List the current version/release/publisher of every terminology the server queries.

tools.name: terminology_diff
tools.description: Report available diff data between two versions of a terminology (real ICD-10 to ICD-11 summary).

resources.name: Server info
resources.description: Version, tool count, supported terminologies and feature-flag state.

resources.name: CID-10 chapters
resources.description: The 22 CID-10 chapters (Brazilian Portuguese ICD-10, DataSUS V2008) with code ranges and descriptions.

resources.name: Terminology licenses
resources.description: Per-terminology license disclaimers and access requirements.

resources.name: Usage stats (hosted endpoint)
resources.description: Per-tool invocation counts recorded by the hosted Cloudflare Workers endpoint.

prompts.name: find-medical-code
prompts.description: Search a clinical condition across all terminologies (ICD-11, LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC, CID-10) in parallel and synthesize the matches with their codes.

prompts.name: drug-info
prompts.description: Compile comprehensive drug information - normalized name, RxCUI, ingredients, therapeutic classes and WHO ATC - by composing RxNorm and ATC calls.

prompts.name: cid10-portuguese-lookup
prompts.description: Look up a Portuguese medical term in the Brazilian CID-10 (DataSUS V2008) with chapter context and clinical description.
